post_revisions_rejection_note.name: post_revisions_rejection_note
post_revisions_rejection_note.value: review_state <> 'rejected' or review_note is not null

post_translations_live_revision.name: post_translations_live_revision
post_translations_live_revision.value: status in ('draft', 'pending_review') or live_revision_id is not null

post_translations_live_slug.name: post_translations_live_slug
post_translations_live_slug.value: live_revision_id is null or slug is not null

post_translations_scheduled_at.name: post_translations_scheduled_at
post_translations_scheduled_at.value: status <> 'scheduled' or scheduled_at is not null

posts_moderation.name: posts_moderation
posts_moderation.value: (hidden_by_moderator = 0 and hidden_by is null and hidden_reason is null and hidden_at is null) or (hidden_by_moderator = 1 and hidden_by is not null and hidden_reason is not null and hidden_at is not null)

user_profiles_ui_locale.name: user_profiles_ui_locale
user_profiles_ui_locale.value: ui_locale is null or ui_locale in ('en', 'tr', 'fr', 'de', 'ja', 'zh-Hans')
